query: Does this PR break the JSON our Go API returns?
expected_behavior: Finds the merge base with git merge-base and runs jsonbreak with --base and the module directory
Lists each BREAK with type, key and file line, and says which readers it affects
Treats exit code 2 as unknown and shows the error instead of calling it a pass

query: I renamed a bunch of struct fields in our event package. Did any json keys change?
expected_behavior: Runs jsonbreak against the last commit or merge base with --pkg set to the event package
Says that Go field renames that keep the json tag are not reported, and lists only the keys that changed

query: We are about to tag v2.4.0 of our Go client. Is the wire format still compatible with v2.3.0?
expected_behavior: Mentions the types it could not check because of custom MarshalJSON or UnmarshalJSON methods, and any removed types that may have been renamed
